auth_rule_token.description: The Auth Rule Token associated with the rule from which the decline originated. If this is set to null, then the decline was not associated with a customer-configured Auth Rule. This may happen in cases where a transaction is declined due to a Lithic-configured security or compliance rule, for example.

result.description: The detailed_result associated with this rule's decline.

name.description: The name for the rule, if any was configured.

explanation.description: A human-readable explanation outlining the motivation for the rule's decline.
